selections.rationale: Provides the strongest governed-platform signal through specific dispatch, grounding, and human-override mechanisms without keyword stuffing.
Connects platform adoption to customer value realization and usage-based forecasting while remaining distinct from the technical delivery bullets.
Combines audit-grade observability, evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls into a concise production-trust outcome.
Clearly covers the end-to-end solution lifecycle and ties orchestration and replayability to movement from intake through monitoring.
Uses concrete infrastructure anchors, including AWS and Databricks Lakehouse, while preserving a focused high-availability architecture claim.
Preserves the protected 8-to-28 team-growth metric and links leadership scale to platform commercialization and a repeatable operating model.
